title: Rāga Bhūpālī and Note Elaboration
summary: Notation only: the marked ascent and descent of Bhūpālī with four svara-vistāras (note elaborations), then the same for Madhyamādi (Madhumād) Sāraṅg with five, using the pause and vādī–saṃvādī signs just introduced.

blocks.text: Sa Re [Ga] Pa Dha ) Ṡa | Ṡa Dha Pa Ga Re Sa |
(1) Sa Re Ga + Re Re Ga, Re Ga, GaRe Sa) GaRe SaRe GaPa Dha– Pa Ga + Pa Ga Re Ga, Re Ga Re – Sa |
(2) Sa Ḍha – Sa Re Ga, + Ḍha Ḍha Sa Re – SaRe Ga – Re Ga – Pa Ga + Re Sa || ReGa Pa Ga, Ḍha Sa DhaRe –, SaRe SaGa – ReGa RePa – Ga, Pa Pa Pa GaPa Dha – Pa Ga, Ga Pa Re Ga – Re Sa
(3) Sa Re Ga Pa Ga Pa, Re Ga – ReGa Dha Pa+ SaRe GaRe SaRe Ga Pa Dha – Pa Ga Pa+Ga Ga Dha Pa, Ga Pa Ṡa Dha – Ga Dha Pa, Pa Re Ga – Re Sa || Ga Re – Ḍha Ḍha Sa||

(4) Ga Pa Dha Dha – Pa Dha Ṡa, Ga Pa Dha Ṙe Ṡa, Sa Re Ga ReGa Pa GaPa Dha PaDha Ṡa, Dha Ṙe Ṡa, Ġa – Ṙe Ṡa Ġa Ṙe – Dha Dha Ṙe Ṡa, Ṡa DhaPa DhaPa Ga – ReSa   Re Ga PaDha Ṡa DhaṠa DhaPa Ga, Re Ga Re Pa Ga, Re Ga Re – Ḍha Ḍha Re Sa|
Āroha avaroha (ascent and descent) - Sa Re Ma Pa) Ṇi Ṡa| Ṡa N̲i̲ Pa Ma Re Ṇ̲i̲ Ṇ̲i̲ Sa|
(1) Ṇ̲i̲ Sa Re, Sa Re, Ṇ̲i̲ Sa ReMa Re, Ṇ̲i̲ Ṇ̲i̲ Ma Re MaRe Ṇi Sa Re Sa|
(2) Ṇ̲i̲Sa Re MaRe, Pa – Ma Pa Ma Re, MaPa N̲i̲ Pa N̲i̲  Pa Ma Re, Ṇ̲i̲ Re  Sa|
(3) MaRe MaPa MaPa, Sa Re Re Ma Ma Pa, Re Ma + Pa Ni Pa, MaPa N̲i̲ Pa MaRe – Sa|
(4) Ma Pa Ma Re Ma Pa Ma Pa Ma Re – Ma Pa, Re Ma Re Pa – Ma Pa Ma N̲i̲ – Pa, Ma Re – Ṇ̲i̲ Re – Sa|
(5) Re Ma Pa N̲i̲ N̲i̲ – Pa Pa N̲i̲ N̲i̲ Ṡa, ReMa PaṆi Ṡa – + Ṇ̲i̲ Ṙe – Ṡa, Ṡa N̲i̲ Pa, Re – Ma N̲i̲ Pa Ma N̲i̲ Ma Pa Re – Ṇ̲i̲ Re – Sa|
